card.name: Unix file permission strings
card.fires_on: Pieces inside the rwx permission string of a Unix directory listing, such as drwxr-xr-x or -rw-r--r--. It fires on the middle characters after the first few.

modes.label: Inside ls -l permissions
modes.description: Middle characters of a permission string at the start of a file listing line, before owner and group names like root wheel.

card.plain: It marks the middle of the rwx-style permission codes shown when listing files on a Unix system.
evidence: 809 drwxr-xr-x 1 root wheel 16384 Dec 31 1979 . dr<<wx>>r-xr-x 28 root
